about.summary: I'm a Senior Backend Engineer specializing in distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and microservices. My core stack is Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL on Docker-based infrastructure. I've led engineering teams, migrated production monoliths to Kafka-based event-driven architectures processing millions of events per day, and shipped multi-tenant SaaS products from zero to hundreds of customers — always with a focus on reliability, observability, and real-world scale.
